name: permittivitycalc
method: NRW (nrw=True) and Boughriet 1997 NNI (nrw=False) per frequency; separate AirlineIter: Cole-Cole model fit to S-params (lmfit/emcee, modified Baker-Jarvis/Houtz 2016)
nrw_variant: classic NRW: X=(S11^2-S21^2+1)/2S11, Gamma=X+-sqrt(X^2-1), T=(S11+S21-G)/(1-(S11+S21)G), 1/Lambda=sqrt(-(ln(1/T)/2piL)^2); NNI eps_eff=(lambda_og/Lambda)^2
eps_mu: NRW: eps and mu; NNI: eps only (mu=1)
geometry: coax airline (LAM_C global = inf; VAL/PAL/GAL airline dims; boundary/gap corrections)
phase_handling: np.unwrap(angle(T)) from principal value at first frequency; ln(1/T) built as ln(1/|T|) + j*unwrap(angle T) (sign wrong for exp(+jwt))
gamma_root_selection: sign[np.absolute(gam1<=1)] - complex '<=' is lexicographic in NumPy (Re first), not |gam1|<=1
half_wavelength_treatment: NRW acknowledged unstable at n*lambda/2; NNI offered as the stable alternative; computes resonant frequencies and averages eps between them (Hickson 2018)
reference_plane_handling: optional washer de-embedding with synthetic PTFE washers (corr=...); no general plane offsets
sparam_usage: forward (S11,S21) and reverse (S22,S12) computed separately, then averaged
touchstone_support: no; reads METAS VNA Tools II text export (mag/deg with uncertainties)
dependencies: numpy scipy matplotlib seaborn uncertainties lmfit emcee corner tqdm tkinter
tests: unittest suite (~100 tests) but NRW tests only assertIsNotNone - no numerical accuracy checks
example_datasets: real measured: rexolite_PAL.txt, serpentine_dry.txt (METAS VNA Tools II output with uncertainties, coax airline)
defects_and_questionable_assumptions: (1) ln(1/T)=ln(1/|T|)+j*arg(T) uses +arg T: conjugates gamma; NNI result is therefore conj(eps) (reported as positive lossfac), but in NRW mode the conjugated gamma is mixed with unconjugated Gamma -> for mu=1 returns eps=|eps| (real) and |mu|=1 complex: wrong for every lossy sample. Internally inconsistent: its own iter_data/_de_embed forward models use T=exp(-gamma L), eps=eps'-j eps''. (2) Gamma root chosen with lexicographic complex '<=' (wrong in ~25% of the unit disk, Re Gamma>0 region; works for ordinary dielectrics where Re Gamma<0); relies on deprecated-style complex ordering. (3) NNI cutoff term typo (lam_0**2/LAM_C*2 instead of /LAM_C**2) - harmless for coax, wrong for waveguide (smoke wg_A NNI error 1.3). (4) new_t = 1j*phase + |t| (used in uncertainty derivative) is not a complex number of T. (5) in-place np.radians on phase rows of stored data.
execution_notes: [permittivitycalc_nrw] max rel err (max over eps,mu): coax_A=0.025, coax_B=0.099, wg_A=0.03, coax_B_L12=0.099, coax_B_L30=1 ; [permittivitycalc_nni] max rel err (max over eps,mu): coax_A=4.6e-14, coax_B=1, wg_A=1.3, coax_B_L12=1, coax_B_L30=1. Conversion: eps=dielec-j*lossfac (package reports eps''>=0). NRW mode wrong for all lossy cases (defect 1); NNI exact for mu=1 coax, fails for mu!=1 (by assumption) and for waveguide (defect 3); no branch index beyond unwrap -> L30 fails.

name: scatter-opt
method: NRW (R&S Annex 2 form) and NNI per frequency; branch selection by GroupDelay (Weir), Kramers-Kronig (Szabo 2010) or RF-Toolbox rationalfit of gamma; Domich/Baker-Jarvis nonlinear LSQ fit of Debye/Lorentz-type models (lm_*, de_*)
nrw_variant: classic NRW with branch integer p: log(1/T)=ln|1/T|+j(unwrap(angle(1/T))+2 pi p); mu=(1+G)/(Lambda(1-G)sqrt(1/l0^2-1/lc^2)); eps=l0^2/mu(1/lc^2+1/Lambda^2)
eps_mu: eps and mu (NRW); eps with mu=1 (NNI)
geometry: waveguide or coax via lambda_c (user supplies lambda_c)
phase_handling: unwrap(angle(1/T)) + 2 pi * BaseBranch; base branch from GroupDelay / KK / rationalfit / manual; discontinuity check on eps (warning only)
gamma_root_selection: |Gamma|<1 test on both roots; errors if neither (also errors if Gamma==0 exactly)
half_wavelength_treatment: none explicit in NRW; optional FitS (rational fit smoothing of S) and NNI option
reference_plane_handling: OptimizeL: fits sample position L1,L2 in holder and de-embeds S11/R1^2, S22/R2^2, S21/(R1R2); PhaseCorrect option in Sproc.load multiplies S21,S12 by exp(-gamma0 L); gamma0 uses c_lab=299704644.54 (air)
sparam_usage: S11,S21 by default; GeoMean option replaces S11 by sqrt(S11*S22) with sign fix; OptimizeL averages S11/S22
touchstone_support: no; whitespace text table freq, dB/deg for S11,S21,S12,S22
dependencies: MATLAB; RF Toolbox (rationalfit, default branch method); Optimization Toolbox (lsqcurvefit/optimoptions in fits); table class
example_datasets: data/X_band_teflon_notape.txt, data/X_40NZF_notape_Ag_31Jan.txt (X-band text data, provenance not documented; README figure captions refer to 'measured S parameters')
defects_and_questionable_assumptions: (1) GroupDelay branch test is degenerate: tcalc=-L*d/df sqrt(eps mu/l0^2-1/lc^2)=-L*d(1/Lambda_p)/df and the 2 pi p offset is frequency-independent, so all non-sign-flipped branches get identical error (confirmed: branches 0,1,2 error 0.010644 each for WR-90 case; it picked 2). (2) KK branch method uses k0=2*freq/c (missing pi). (3) default branch method needs MATLAB RF Toolbox. (4) nrw_ref_coef flags Gamma==0 as 'no root'. (5) 'import scatter_opt.*' and table/height not available in Octave. Author disclaimer: 'hastily developed', unmaintained since 2020.

Residual 6e-13 is its c_vac=299792458.000176. manual BaseBranch=0 fails only when m>=1 at f_min (L30); GD fixes L30 by luck but picks a wrong branch on wg_A (defect 1).

name: nrw_method_eps_mu
method: NRW with per-frequency group-delay branch search (n in -10..10); also gmpy2 high-precision forward/backward variant (nrw_gmpy2.py)
nrw_variant: classic NRW (R&S / Luukkonen refs); ln(1/T) real part + j*(unwrap(Im ln(1/T)) + 2 pi n)
geometry: coax/free space (lambda_cut=inf) or waveguide via lambda_cut
phase_handling: np.unwrap of Im ln(1/T), then per-frequency choice of n by argmin |Re tau_calc + Re tau_meas|
touchstone_support: writes a simple .s2p (save_s2p uses undefined global f); no reader
example_datasets: synthetic only; 'literature' folder with 3.7 MB of papers
defects_and_questionable_assumptions: (1) written for exp(-iwt): branch rule min|tau_calc+tau_meas| requires d(arg T)/df>0; with standard VNA exp(+jwt) data it picks wrong branches everywhere (coax_A err 13 without conjugation). (2) group-delay criterion is analytically branch-independent (tau_calc=L d(1/Lambda_n)/df; numerically identical to ~1e-4 ns across n), so the choice rests on round-off/sign flips of the principal sqrt - happened to be right in all our synthetic cases but is not a sound discriminator. (3) branch chosen independently per frequency (no continuity). (4) nrw_reverse picks |Gamma|>1 root and gives NaN for lambda_cut=inf (complex 1/inf).
execution_notes: [kasbrot_nrw] max rel err (max over eps,mu): coax_A=4.4e-15, coax_B=1.4e-15, wg_A=1.8e-15, coax_B_L12=1.1e-15, coax_B_L30=1.3e-15. Adapter conjugates inputs/outputs (exp(-iwt) code).

name: Nicolson-Ross-Weir-Materal-Parameter-Extraction
method: NRW per NIST TN 1536 p.112
nrw_variant: classic NRW, branch fixed at m=0: lnZ1=log|Z1|+j(angle(Z1)-2 pi*0); 1/Lambda=sqrt(invGamSq) principal
phase_handling: none (principal angle, no unwrap); group-delay tCalc/tMeas computed but never used

(2) mu uses sqrt(invGamSq) principal branch (sign of 1/Lambda not controlled). (3) magTanD=imag/real vs tanD=-imag/real: opposite sign conventions for the two loss tangents; plots show abs(). (4) script (clear/clc) rather than function.

name: Nicholson-Ross-Weir-Algorithm
method: NRW function NRW.m + driver averaging forward/reverse, GA search of sample position for reference-plane rotation
nrw_variant: classic NRW; 1/Lambda root with Re>=0; mu=2pi/Lambda (1+R)/(1-R)/sqrt(k^2-kc^2)
geometry: coax (fc=0 in driver) or waveguide via kc
phase_handling: detects jumps >pi in Im log(1/T); adds +2 pi to all points after the FIRST jump only
reference_plane_handling: rotate.m: moves planes by position/holder length; position found by ga() minimising phase mismatch of S11 vs S22 (needs Global Optimization Toolbox)
example_datasets: real measured: 11-4.74.txt, 22-2.txt (instrument T/R export with holder 6.95 mm, samples 4.74 mm and 2.00 mm, coax, provenance not stated)
defects_and_questionable_assumptions: (1) 'for m = index+1:length' with vector index uses only the first jump and adds exactly 2 pi to everything after it: 2nd and later wraps are not corrected (coax_B_L12: only 40% of points correct). (2) cannot start on m>=1. (3) driver uses c=3.0e8.

name: 5G-New-Material-EM-Characterization-Techniques
method: Baker-Jarvis (NIST TN 1355-R) reference-plane-invariant closed form (NRW_BJ_TEM*.m) + time gating, band union, de-embedding scripts
nrw_variant: A=S11S22/(S21S12), B=exp(2gamma0(Lair-L))(S21S12-S11S22); Gamma^2 from quadratic; P from S21/S21_air; n=ln(1/P)/(gamma0 L); Z=(1-Gamma)/(1+Gamma) with principal sqrt Gamma
geometry: TEM only (gamma_1=j w/c); NRW_BJ_TEM_medio has 'aire'/other medium (hard-coded 1.49)
gamma_root_selection: picks Gamma^2 root with |.|<1, then Gamma=principal sqrt (Re>=0) and Z=(1-Gamma)/(1+Gamma): implicit assumption Re(Gamma_true)<0, i.e. |z|<1 (eps>mu-like)
half_wavelength_treatment: reference-plane-invariant formulation; no special n*lambda/2 handling
reference_plane_handling: invariant: needs holder length Lair and empty-holder S21_air; sample position not needed
defects_and_questionable_assumptions: (1) sign of Gamma fixed by principal sqrt -> for samples with Re Gamma>0 (mu/eps > 1-ish, e.g. magnetic absorbers) Z is inverted, eps and mu swap roles. (2) n=NUEVA/(gamma0 L) is TEM-only. (3) NRW_BJ_TEM_3 sensitivity uses hard-coded 0.1433e-3 m length uncertainty. (4) many near-duplicate scripts.
execution_notes: [bj_tem_5g] max rel err (max over eps,mu): coax_A=8.2e-15, coax_B=3.5e-15, wg_A=n/a(unsupported), coax_B_L12=3.9e-15, coax_B_L30=1.1. Adapter uses Lair=L and ideal S21_air=exp(-j k0 L).
